prompt: Compact industrial wheeled inspection robot, low-poly game-ready 3D model. A small ground rover: flat rectangular chassis with slightly rounded corners, four small rugged wheels partially recessed into the body, a short front sensor mast with a compact stereo camera housing (two small lenses), one small amber warning beacon on the rear corner. Clean utilitarian proportions, understated matte materials: warm dark gray body panels, soft graphite accents, subtle teal accent stripe along the side. No text, no logos, no humanoid features, no weapons. Single cohesive object on flat ground, neutral studio lighting.
